items.t: Deere (DE) Will Close Two Iowa Plants And Shift Some Production To Brazil
items.sum: Deere (NYSE:DE) plans to close two manufacturing plants in Iowa as part of a broader rework of its production footprint. The machinery producer intends to shift some of the affected output to other US facilities and move additional work to Brazil.
